name: Teodor
title: The Cooper, Three Winters Dead
summary: Widow Ileana's husband: a cooper who went to the crossroads for a barrel and came back a vampire spawn, pale and very polite. He has knocked at her shutter every night since and never once asked to come in.

guest_build.note: His own stat block (a vampire spawn). Stands with the party for one fight at Ileana's door (The Polite Caller) and leaves at dawn.
